name: Pharaoh's Pyramid
text: After scoring, your team gains +5 points for every 50 gold you have.
archetypes: Gold Miner; splash Diamond Flood, Swap Meet
family: Gold and points conversion / Gold to points
decision: At every shop, whether to spend gold on a sigil or bank it for points.
opponent: Visible each round; no effect on opponents' cards.
aiNote: Spend normally through round 8, then buy only offers worth more than 10 gold per point and bank the rest.
rationale: Pays about +25 to +50 flat points each round without spending the gold; a dedicated miner holds 250 to 500 gold mid-run, so the late value sits at the top of the uncommon band and OR-R03 stays the big converter. Holding more gold than that means skipping purchases, which limits it in place of a cap. Gold is counted before the round's income, and the points count toward this round's 1,000 check.
notes: Is this really enough gold? It doesn't seem like very much.
